details: Investors are positioning cautiously ahead of the US Federal Reserve's July 29th interest rate decision. Policymakers are widely expected to keep rates unchanged, but any hawkish guidance reinforcing a "higher for longer" rate outlook could cap further gains in the crypto markets. Bitcoin has experienced volatility in anticipation.
title: Crypto Market Cautious Ahead of Fed Rate Decision

details: South Korea's benchmark KOSPI index tumbled over 10% due to growing worries over artificial intelligence spending, leading to a sharp sell-off in semiconductor stocks. This AI-led tech downturn has created a global risk-off environment, weighing on other risk assets including cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin.
title: AI Sell-off Triggers Broader Risk-Off, Impacts Crypto

details: With US federal debt reaching $39.7 trillion and growing rapidly, investors are increasingly seeking Bitcoin as a hedge against potential US dollar devaluation. Concerns about currency debasement are rising, making Bitcoin's fixed supply an attractive alternative as a store of value compared to the unlimited printing of dollars.
title: US Debt Soars, Fueling Bitcoin as Devaluation Hedge

details: The FTX Recovery Trust is set to distribute nearly $900 million to creditors in its fifth payout. Market participants are closely monitoring whether a meaningful portion of these funds will be reinvested into cryptocurrencies, which could potentially boost market liquidity and prices.
title: FTX Recovery Trust Prepares $900M Creditor Payout

details: The CLARITY Act is making progress in the US Senate, with lawmakers working to get it passed before the August 7th recess. This legislation aims to provide a dedicated federal registration route for spot digital commodity trading, potentially reducing the SEC's ability to treat nearly every token transaction as a security.
title: CLARITY Act Nears Vote, Key for US Crypto Regulation

details: In what some are calling "Hackers Day," three crypto protocols—AFX Trade, BSquaredNetwork, and Verus—were exploited within the last 24 hours, collectively losing over $35 million in crypto assets. This highlights acute security risks for DeFi protocols and could pressure token prices and adoption.
title: Multiple Crypto Protocols Lose $35M in Exploits
